features: Happy Halloween! 🎃 The new Halloween Edition: haunted Home with a glowing moon, castle, bats and pumpkins, a cursed Magic Cube, and the Mystery Capsule (Trick or Track)

New Gesture Music: double tap and hold, then draw with a glitter glitch trail. Circle opens Favorites, wave opens Recently played, diagonal shuffles, heart likes the song, or write a song name and it plays
Time Fold: explore what you played by day in a 3D card view, or browse songs by language through the years
Liquid touch effect when you open a song
Pattukal Blue is the new default app icon, and the notification icon is now always the Pattukal mark
New features and stability maximised: faster, steadier Home and refresh, Settings Back button fixed
Performance mode, Karaoke mode, Wavy player slider with new slider styles, Taste AI and the new Home layout
bug_fixes: Settings Back button now works after opening a setting
Home refresh no longer makes the list jump
